actor: agent-defined offline evaluation assumptions; not a human-approved business policy

split.method: Exact prefix/length-filtered token-set Jaccard join; connected components assigned whole by deterministic label-balanced greedy allocation
split.quarantine: Whole component if empty/no-token text or conflicting labels on identical normalized text; no relabeling of similar-but-not-identical content

model_selection.selection: Highest validation macro F1 among eligible logistic candidates; exact ties prefer logistic_c05; no replacement candidate after results
model_selection.no_eligible_candidate: No quality-qualified model; report results and keep review-needed fallback, without relaxing targets

gating.reference_method: Inclusive empirical bounds at q and 1-q, linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; compare unrounded values
gating.selection: Among feasible threshold/tail pairs, minimize assumed mean review+error cost; ties within 1e-12 prefer greater standard coverage, then greater score threshold, then smaller tail
gating.no_feasible_pair: All valid predictions require triage review; no default permissive gate

assumed_error_costs.unit: dimensionless illustrative review effort; not minutes, money or measured business loss
assumed_error_costs.formula: Mean(queue review cost + error penalty for wrong standard suggestions); adjudication itself is not assumed perfect or measured
assumed_error_costs.sensitivity_use: Report on validation only; does not change the primary selected configuration

final_test.use: V01 only after candidate, model hashes, threshold, reference and software are frozen
final_test.failure: Report failure/limitation and retain assisted/manual fallback; no tuning or second clean-test claim on the same membership
final_test.exposure: No final-test examples in development/UI; any reuse affecting selection creates a new exploratory version with disclosed contamination
